objective: Measure hallucination risk and overconfidence indicators over the deterministic retrieval corpus — a read-only advisory measurement (how risky the corpus is to present as fact). Makes no determination and blocks nothing.

summary.migrator_change: None — read-only advisory measurement with NO DB writes at all (no dedicated risk table exists/is reserved in V38). Schema stays 38, contract table count stays 190.
summary.reuse: Prompt 28's detect_and_route_claims (fabrication signal); the deterministic RetrievalBroker + RetrievalEnvelope (degradation/coverage/stale/conflict + tier distribution); EXCLUDED_FAMILIES.

design.hallucination_risk_indicators: unsupported claims (fabrication), tier-3 items presented as fact, stale/conflict items, coverage gaps, degradation mode.
design.overconfidence_indicators: high confidence on weakly-grounded items (tier-3 / unsupported / stale-or-conflict); high_confidence_tier3 mismatch count; confidence distribution.
design.risk_band: Deterministic: high if any unsupported claim OR degradation=blocked OR overconfidence-rate > high_overconfidence_rate (0.25); medium if any overconfidence OR tier3-share > high_tier3_share (0.50) OR stale/conflict OR degradation=narrow_claims OR coverage gap; else low. Plus an indicators list.
design.doctrine: Advisory measurement — assembles_final_answer=false, makes_determination=false, blocks_nothing=true. Persists nothing (no DB writes). Metadata-only: counts, bucketed bands, distributions, family names, indicator flags — no raw content/source ref.

operator_db_outcome.rationale: On the real operator corpus there are no unsupported claims and no overconfidence (the corpus is well source-grounded — consistent with Prompt 28's 0 unsupported), but a coverage gap and a degraded retrieval mode fire -> medium risk. An honest, nuanced assessment.
